# Agent Discovery Network

Experimental trust-filtered discovery index for agents, resources and services.

- Project: https://github.com/PCakes303/agent-intelligence-ecosystem
- Contract: docs/DISCOVERY-CONTRACT.md
- Threat model: docs/THREAT-MODEL.md
- Record validation: discovery_network/records.py
- Registry: discovery_network/registry.py
- Tests: tests/

Discovery is not authentication, authorization, endpoint health verification or capability certification. Signature and trust callbacks are integration seams; no cryptographic or distributed implementation is included.
